contract:
# Render evidence as one bounded repair input

A tenant needs to start a repair request and see that it prepares a local draft. A gallery visitor needs to identify the work in Room 4 and see its material note. Keep the opening calm and practical. Preserve each draft's palette, lettering, content and single focal element. Maintenance already uses the cool grouped worksheet. Gallery uses its paper, ink, light plaster field and plum room mark. Compact the opening around the first field or note. Omit newly invented content and extra decoration.

Freeze the installed treatment on form-maintenance and the installed release's earlier mobile-gallery draft. On maintenance, preserve validation, prepared confirmation, all values and edit recovery. At 320 and 390 px, the first labeled input must end by y=330 and the local draft message must be in view before input. Required cues must remain visible. On gallery, preserve Room 4, River Wall, Maya Chen, 1972 and Pigment on plaster. The whole disclosure must end by y=560 at 390 and y=535 at 320. After opening by keyboard, the visible note should start at least 8 CSS px below the visible focus ring. Enter toggles twice, the note is announced, and focus stays on the same control. Verify no overflow and exercise both drafts at 1440 as well. Use the same policy for fonts and images.

Both repairs receive the identical original source, original 390 px PNG, task, assertions, and one revision opportunity in an empty, shell-disabled Terra session. The measured arm also receives compact screen coordinates, focus and spacing readings from the original browser. Neither receives a proposed CSS patch. Use the installed Design MCP check tool once after revising, then save the generated bytes. Compare the functional and visual checks separately. Judge a pair live only after both playable arms have exact source and journey receipts. Scope the result to two briefs and one repair attempt per arm.

The source direction respects the existing owner's brief-specific art direction. The repair design uses the original cold-start and reversible-action comparisons. [Matched form evidence](../maintenance-first-use/CONTINUATION.md) · [Matched gallery evidence](../storybook-live-gallery/CONTINUATION.md)
generator: Codex 0.170.0, GPT-6.1 Terra low, shell disabled
scope: Two synthetic briefs and one repair opportunity. Both arms receive the same source, screen, critique and targets. Only the measured arm receives coordinates.

calibration.reason: Clear labels and legibility support the task, while the familiar layout limits originality and misplaced focus makes error recovery harder.

primary_action.expected: Focus the material-note button and reveal Pigment on plaster.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab focused Show material note. Enter revealed Pigment on plaster, changed the label to Hide material note, and retained focus on the button.

A-1440.edge_observation: A second Enter collapsed the note, restored Show material note, and retained visible focus on the button.
A-1440.fact_check: Room 4, River Wall, Maya Chen, 1972, and Pigment on plaster are displayed. Their historical accuracy is unsupported by the review.
A-1440.strength: The large serif title, restrained metadata, and plum room mark create a clear gallery hierarchy. The action is easy to find and use.
A-1440.weakness: The reveal sits close to the focused button outline, and the large mark reads primarily as a room number rather than a distinctive artwork.
A-1440.repair: Add a little space between the focus outline and revealed text; give the art mark a more specific visual relationship to the work.

primary_action.expected: Focus the material-note button and reveal Pigment on plaster.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab focused the button. Enter revealed Pigment on plaster and retained focus on Hide material note.

A-390.edge_observation: A second Enter hid the note and left visible focus on Show material note.
A-390.fact_check: All requested identification details and the material note are visible. Their historical accuracy is unsupported by the review.
A-390.strength: The title and supporting details remain legible, and the complete action fits comfortably in the viewport.
A-390.weakness: The art mark is compressed into a very shallow strip, weakening its presence. The revealed text sits close to the focus outline.
A-390.repair: Give the art area more height at mobile width and increase the gap below the focused control.

primary_action.expected: Focus the material-note button and reveal Pigment on plaster.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab focused Show material note. Enter revealed Pigment on plaster, changed the label to Hide material note, and retained focus on the button.

B-1440.edge_observation: A second Enter collapsed the note, restored Show material note, and retained visible focus on the button.
B-1440.fact_check: Room 4, River Wall, Maya Chen, 1972, and Pigment on plaster are displayed. Their historical accuracy is unsupported by the review.
B-1440.strength: The title leads a clear hierarchy, and the spacious two-column composition makes the identification and action straightforward.
B-1440.weakness: The art mark is more suggestive of room signage than the named work. The reveal is close to the focus outline.
B-1440.repair: Make the mark more specific to the work and add breathing room above the revealed text.

primary_action.expected: Focus the material-note button and reveal Pigment on plaster.
primary_action.observed: The first Tab focused the button. Enter revealed Pigment on plaster and retained focus on Hide material note.

B-390.edge_observation: A second Enter hid the note and left visible focus on Show material note.
B-390.fact_check: All requested identification details and the material note are visible. Their historical accuracy is unsupported by the review.
B-390.strength: The taller art panel preserves the room mark's presence while the title, metadata, and action remain legible and visible together.
B-390.weakness: The mark still conveys the room more strongly than the work, and the reveal has little separation from the focus outline.
B-390.repair: Add a more work-specific visual detail and increase the gap between the focused button and the note.

preference.reason: Both completed the keyboard task reliably. B preserves a more substantial art panel at 390 pixels while keeping the identification and action visible; the 1440-pixel initial views appeared identical.
